steps.title: Install the ibis binary
steps.description: Download the runtime from GitHub Releases (no Rust toolchain needed), or point `ibis.runtime.binaryPath` at an existing binary.

steps.title: Choose how to reach the runtime
steps.description: Spawn an isolated child per window (default) or attach to a shared personal runtime.

steps.title: Browse memory and load session context
steps.description: Open the Ibis Assistant view, search typed memory, and let agents load the session contract.

steps.title: Remember with provenance
steps.description: Capture a selection (with file:line range) or a whole-file fact; both bind to the source file and go stale when it changes.

enumDescriptions: Attach to the always-on personal daemon (default endpoint `http://127.0.0.1:3030/mcp`); the status bar shows **Ibis daemon offline** when it is unreachable and **Ibis Assistant: Start Daemon** can launch it detached.
Spawn an isolated `ibis -mode stdio -runtime-mode plugin` child (one per IDE, plugin data dir). Legacy/CI behavior, bit-for-bit.
Attach to the runtime at `#ibis.runtime.mcpUrl#` over Streamable HTTP without the daemon on/offline UX.
ibis.runtime.mode.markdownDescription: How the extension reaches Ibis MCP. `auto` attaches to the always-on personal daemon (`ibis run` / `ibis start`, default `http://127.0.0.1:3030/mcp`); `spawn` keeps the per-window isolated child; `attach` pins a custom endpoint. The `IBIS_MCP_URL` environment variable overrides the endpoint while `mcpUrl` is left at its default.

ibis.runtime.mcpUrl.markdownDescription: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint used when `#ibis.runtime.mode#` is `auto` or `attach` (equivalent of the `IBIS_MCP_URL` environment variable). Start the daemon with **Ibis Assistant: Start Daemon**, `ibis start`, or `ibis run`.

ibis.runtime.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Command name or absolute path of the Ibis Assistant binary used when spawning (equivalent of the `IBIS_BIN` environment variable) and by **Ibis Assistant: Start Daemon**.

ibis.runtime.dataDir.markdownDescription: Override the plugin data directory (equivalent of the `IBIS_DATA_DIR` environment variable). Leave empty to use `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ibis\plugin` on Windows or the platform default.

ibis.runtime.runtimeMode.markdownDescription: Value passed to `-runtime-mode` for a spawned child. Keep `plugin` for IDE-owned stdio children; `personal`/`server` are advanced runtime deployments.

ibis.runtime.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra CLI arguments appended after `-mode stdio -runtime-mode <mode>` when spawning the child.

ibis.runtime.workspaceOverride.markdownDescription: Explicit opened-folder path exported as `IBIS_WORKSPACE` (equivalent of the `IBIS_WORKSPACE` environment variable). Leave empty to auto-detect the first VS Code workspace folder.

ibis.runtime.autoAttach.markdownDescription: Only in explicit `spawn` mode: first probe `#ibis.runtime.autoAttachProbeUrls#` and attach to a reachable personal runtime instead of starting an isolated child.

ibis.runtime.autoAttachProbeUrls.markdownDescription: Loopback Streamable HTTP MCP endpoints probed in order when `#ibis.runtime.autoAttach#` is enabled.

ibis.mcp.registerProvider.markdownDescription: Register the Ibis Assistant MCP server-definition provider so VS Code agent mode can start the server automatically. Requires a window reload when changed.

ibis.lmBridge.enabled.markdownDescription: Start the IDE language-model bridge on `127.0.0.1` so the runtime can use VS Code-provided models (runtime setting `ai.reasoning.use_ide_provided_models`). Requires a window reload when changed.

ibis.lmBridge.port.markdownDescription: Loopback port of the IDE LM bridge (equivalent of the `IBIS_LM_BRIDGE_PORT` environment variable). Requires a window reload when changed.

ibis.lmBridge.url.markdownDescription: Explicit bridge URL exported as `IBIS_LM_BRIDGE_URL` to the runtime (equivalent of the same environment variable). Leave empty to derive `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` from `#ibis.lmBridge.port#`.

ibis.lmBridge.modelFamily.markdownDescription: Optional `vscode.lm` model family filter (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-3.5-sonnet`). Leave empty to use the first available IDE-provided model.

ibis.settings.url.markdownDescription: Explicit Ibis Settings UI URL opened by **Ibis Assistant: Open Settings** (equivalent of the `IBIS_SETTINGS_URL` environment variable). Leave empty to probe `#ibis.settings.probeUrls#` and fall back to the MCP `settings_open_ui` tool.

ibis.settings.probeUrls.markdownDescription: Personal Settings UI endpoints probed in order by **Ibis Assistant: Open Settings** before falling back to the ephemeral loopback Settings URL from MCP `settings_open_ui`.

ibis.settings.probeTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Per-endpoint timeout (milliseconds) when probing personal HTTP settings and auto-attach URLs.

ibis.identity.actor.markdownDescription: Actor identity sent as the `X-Ibis-Actor` header on every MCP request in attach/daemon mode (equivalent of the `IBIS_ACTOR` environment variable). Attributes shared rows on team servers and drives the curation **Update Content** guard; leave empty to stay the anonymous local actor (`unknown`). The runtime trusts the header from loopback peers only — on a LAN team server attribute via the tools' `actor` argument instead.

enumDescriptions: Personal claims render as title-only stub files in `.ibis/claims/` (redacted, body stays in the runtime database) — the personal-mode default.
Personal claims never touch the repo tree: SurrealDB rows only (the team/server default).
ibis.claims.personalMode.markdownDescription: Personal-claims policy passed to the runtime as `IBIS_CLAIMS_PERSONAL_MODE` (F4 §B.7, claim-store addendum §4c). Forwarded for spawned children and daemons started with **Ibis Assistant: Start Daemon** when this setting is explicitly configured — there it overrides the runtime `config.json` choice; a daemon started elsewhere keeps its boot-time policy.

enumDescriptions: Always show the kind quick pick in **Ibis Assistant: Remember**.
A choice the team should keep.
What resolved a failure.
A durable constraint or convention.
A hard boundary the project must respect.
A trap future agents should avoid.
A design rationale worth keeping.
A verifiable statement about the project.
ibis.memory.defaultKind.markdownDescription: Typed memory kind used by **Ibis Assistant: Remember**. `ask` keeps the interactive quick pick; any other value skips it and writes directly.

enumDescriptions: Sharing-first default: any client that can reach the runtime sees it.
Visible only to the resolved owner actor.
ibis.memory.defaultVisibility.markdownDescription: `visibility` passed to MCP `memory_add` by **Ibis Assistant: Remember**.

enumDescriptions: Only memories whose status is `current` (and not expired) — the clean-browse default.
Every status (`current`, `superseded`, `archived`, `stale`) — the curation browse where nothing is hidden.
ibis.memory.statusFilter.markdownDescription: Status filter for the Memory tree kind browse and search (`memory_list` / `memory_search`), the Workstreams view children, and the search results. Toggle it from the view title with **Ibis Assistant: Toggle Memory Status Filter**; both view titles show `all` when the unfiltered browse is active.

ibis.workingState.useWorkspaceProject.markdownDescription: Send the first workspace folder name as `project_name` when **Ibis Assistant: Set working state** calls MCP `set_working_state`.

enumDescriptions: Show **Ibis Assistant: Status** as a notification window.
Write **Ibis Assistant: Status** and diagnostics to the Ibis Assistant output channel.
Both notification and output channel.
ibis.status.outputMode.markdownDescription: Where **Ibis Assistant: Status** reports backend, shared-runtime, and LM-bridge details.

ibis.debug.verboseLogging.markdownDescription: Log verbose activation and backend-resolution details to the Ibis Assistant output channel.
